context_requirements: Expression of LPAR1 and/or LPAR3 on the cell surface
Availability of bioactive LPA in the assay medium or local environment
Intact G12/13-Rho and Gq-Ca2+ signaling downstream of LPAR
Proliferative or migratory phenotype dependent on LPA signaling
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) at 6 h in any cell line
No reduction in proliferation-associated genes at 24 h in any cell line
Strong and uniform upregulation of immediate-early genes across all nine lines, suggesting off-target or non-specific stress rather than LPAR antagonism
No difference in response between lines known to express LPAR1/3 and lines that do not

changes: Removed TIMP2 and SERPINE1 from late_up because they already appear in proximal_up; a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time, and duplicate placement across time lists is not justified by the mechanism.
Removed generic proliferation and stress genes (e.g., MYC, CCND1, PCNA, CDKN1A, GADD45A/B) from proximal lists; these are downstream/generic effects, not proximal LPAR antagonism readouts.
Corrected line_response: A549, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP set to weak because these lines have low/absent LPAR1/3 expression or LPA-independent proliferation, contradicting moderate responses.

Corrected kinetics to fast for immediate-early gene induction and magnitude to weak at 6 h and weak at 24 h, because LPAR antagonism primarily blunts LPA-driven immediate-early signaling rather than causing slow moderate transcriptional changes.
Removed all evidence citations because none were provided and no abstract-supported claims can be retained.
